test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2023: Official Paper (Held On: 10 Aug, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Read the given statements and conclusions carefully. You have to take the given statements to be true even if they seem to be at variance from commonly known facts. You have to decide which conclusion/s logically follow/s from the given statements.

**Statements:**

Some tables are caps.

All caps are bikes.

All bikes are pins.

**Conclusion (I): **Some pins are tables.

**Conclusion (II):** Some caps are not pins.
solution:
The least possible venn diagram is shown below,

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e7935a25c8e853e4e37d5ed55dcfaddd5247a2597416b291d91b2133722fa80d.png] 

Conclusion (I): Some pins are tables → **Follows** (Because Some tables are caps, all caps are bikes, and all bikes are pins).

Conclusion (II): Some caps are not pins → **Not follows** (Because all caps are bikes, and all bikes are pins).

Hence, the correct answer is **"****Only conclusion (I) is true"**.
